content: Hi, I'm looking for a beginner photography class that meets on Saturdays and costs under S$50. Do you have any recommendations?

Here’s a shortlist that matches your criteria (Saturday class, ≤ S$50):

- **Photography and Photo Enhancement with AI (AI30)** – Toa Payoh West CC  
  • **Venue:** Toa Payoh West CC (planning area: Toa Payoh)  
  • **Schedule:** Saturday, 14:00‑17:00, one 3‑hour session on 12 Dec 2026  
  • **Fee:** S$10 (materials fee may apply; other checkout costs unconfirmed)  
  • **Content:** Smartphone photo capture and AI‑assisted editing  
  • **Link:** https://www.onepa.gov.sg/courses/photography-and-photo-enhancement-with-ai-ai30-c027245625  

**Unresolved constraints**  
- The venue is in Toa Payoh; proximity to your preferred area is unverified.  
- Additional material fees and funding eligibility are unconfirmed.  
- No other Saturday‑only courses under S$50 appear in this snapshot.  

If you’d like to explore a different topic, a broader budget, or a different day, just let me know!
